title: feat(ai): provider HTTP clients, keychain keys and offline-only mode
body:
**New third-party crates - needs the maintainer's decision (`needs-maintainer`):**

| Crate | Version | Licence | Why the workspace's existing deps can't do it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reqwest` | 0.12.28 (default features off, `rustls-tls`) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Provides an async HTTP request that cancellation can interrupt. Redirects and environment proxies are disabled. |
| `tokio` | 1.52.3 (`rt`, `time`, `net`, `macros`) | MIT | Runs each request on a current-thread runtime inside the chat worker. Cancellation drops the active request future. |
| `rustls` / `rustls-webpki` / `rustls-pki-types` | 0.23.46 / 0.103.17 / 1.16.0 (via reqwest) | Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT / ISC / MIT OR Apache-2.0 | TLS for the https cloud APIs; no OpenSSL on Linux. |
| `ring` + `untrusted` | 0.17.14 / 0.9.0 (via rustls) | Apache-2.0 AND ISC / ISC | rustls's crypto (C/asm, built by `cc`; no CMake, unlike aws-lc-rs). |
| `webpki-roots` | 1.0.12 | CDLA-Permissive-2.0 | The Mozilla CA roots, so the build needs no system trust store. |
| `keyring` + `keyring-core` | 4.2.0 / 1.0.1 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Nothing in the tree reaches an OS credential store. |
| keyring stores: `apple-native-keyring-store` (+ `security-framework`), `windows-native-keyring-store`, `zbus-secret-service-keyring-store` (+ `secret-service`) | 1.x | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Secret Service. The Linux store rides the `zbus` 5 **already in the lock** - pure Rust, no `libdbus` build package. |
| RustCrypto `aes`, `cbc`, `cipher`, `hkdf`, `hmac`, `sha2`, `digest`, `subtle`, `zeroize`, ... (via secret-service) | various | MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`subtle` BSD-3-Clause) | Secret Service session encryption. |

`url` 2.5 was **already in Cargo.lock** and is now a direct dependency of `camcraft-app` (endpoint parsing with the same URL parser reqwest uses). All new crates are under `[target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'.dependencies]` of `camcraft-app` only; the browser build links none of them. Notices added to `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`. The review fix replaces blocking `ureq` with `reqwest` and a current-thread `tokio` runtime so cancellation interrupts active requests. Considered and dropped: detached blocking requests (they keep the socket and worker alive), `native-tls` (OpenSSL headers on Linux), keyring's dbus store (vendored libdbus C build) - see `docs/decisions/1945-ai-provider-clients.md`.

## What changed

- **`camcraft_app::ai`** (new, `crates/app/src/ai/`):
  - `endpoint` - URL parse (WHATWG `url`; user info, query and fragment refused), loopback test (`localhost`, 127/8, `::1`, IPv4-mapped), `admit` (offline-only reaches loopback alone; plain `http://` off the machine is refused, key or not), `admit_addrs` (the resolver's half).
  - `presets` - Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses (GPT and Codex), Gemini `generateContent` (all `https://`); Ollama `http://localhost:11434/v1`, Unsloth Studio `http://127.0.0.1:8888/v1`, LM Studio `http://localhost:1234/v1`, llama.cpp `llama-server` `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1` (`--jinja` named in the label).
  - `wire` - the request path and body per provider. Tool-call envelopes are echoed in each provider's own shape (Anthropic content blocks, Chat `tool_calls` message, Responses `output` items incl. reasoning, Gemini content incl. `thoughtSignature`); consecutive tool results merge into one Anthropic user message / one Gemini turn. Model ids are checked so they cannot add a query or climb the Gemini path. Fallback (prompt-JSON / Q&A) payloads go into the system prompt with no tools.
  - `probe` - Ollama `/api/show` capabilities -> tools / vision / fallback mode.
  - `secret` - `ApiKey` has no `Display` and a redacted `Debug`, refuses control characters (no header injection); lookup is the env var (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`) first, then the keychain.
  - `http` (native only) - the client. `admit` runs before anything resolves; the agent's resolver refuses non-loopback addresses when offline-only or plain http; **no redirects followed**, **no proxy from the environment**, connect/total timeouts, auth only in headers (`x-api-key`, `Authorization: Bearer`, `x-goog-api-key`), errors carry the host, status and the provider's message - never the key.
  - `keychain` (native only) - `load` / `store` / `forget` under the service `camcraft-ai`.
- **`prefs.json`** gains `aiOfflineOnly` (written only when on); `ViewPrefs` has no field that could hold a key.
- **AI Chat dock** (`crates/ui`): native builds use the new `transport_http::HttpTransport` (presets map to the endpoints above; the key comes from env/keychain or the step is refused by name; an Ollama model without the `tools` capability is refused by name in the native-tools preset, pointing at the Prompt-JSON / Q&A presets). The "Offline only" switch is restored from and saved to `prefs.json`. The browser build keeps the offline-only `DefaultTransport` (now `cfg(wasm32)`).

## How tested

- New `crates/app/tests/ai_http.rs` against a fake loopback HTTP server (no real key: a fixed placeholder sent only to 127.0.0.1): `anthropic_messages_wire_format`, `openai_chat_completions_wire_format`, `openai_responses_wire_format`, `gemini_generate_content_wire_format`, `local_runtimes_send_no_auth_header`, `ollama_capability_probe`, `offline_only_blocks_every_non_loopback_host_before_a_socket` (every cloud preset plus TEST-NET / private / IPv6 hosts refused in < 500 ms, plus the resolver check), `plain_http_off_this_machine_is_refused`, `redirects_are_not_followed_and_errors_never_carry_the_key`. 9/9 pass.
- `crates/app/tests/view_prefs.rs::offline_only_survives_and_the_file_stores_zero_keys` (the file's keys are exactly the known five; no "key"/"token"/"secret"/"password"/"bearer").
- Unit tests in `ai::endpoint`, `ai::presets`, `ai::secret`, `ai::wire`, `ai::probe`, and `transport_http::every_panel_preset_has_an_endpoint`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (fell back to batch: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changed): geometry, kernel, cl, tools, post, sim, motion, app (incl. `ai_http`, `view_prefs`) and ui suites all **ok** (35.5 min). Clippy `-D warnings` FAILS only on `crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115` `MIN_LABEL_PX` never used - pre-existing on upstream main since PR #2095, tracked in #2104 / PR #2111; no other lint in the touched crates.
- `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` (with `web/build-app-wasm.sh`'s wasi sysroot and flecs patch): **Finished** clean; the only warnings are pre-existing unused imports in `ai_chat/worker.rs` (untouched here).

## Not exercised

- No call to a real provider or a real local runtime (no key in tests, no network in tests).
- The OS keychain itself (`keychain::load/store/forget`) is not called by any test - a test would prompt or write the developer's real keychain; the lookup order is pinned with an injected keychain.
- No UI for entering/storing a key yet: keys come from the env vars, or from the keychain if stored by other means (service `camcraft-ai`, account `anthropic`/`openai`/`gemini`). A key-entry field is a follow-up.
- Streaming responses (each step is one complete response, as the dock's worker expects).

Changelog: AI Chat reaches Anthropic, OpenAI (Chat and Responses), Gemini over https and Ollama, Unsloth Studio, LM Studio and llama-server on loopback; API keys come only from the environment or the OS keychain; "Offline only" is saved and blocks every non-loopback host in the HTTP client (#1945)
Effort: high (not escalated)
Process change: no
Fork: mkinney fork, branched from upstream/main 780b0a25a

Fixes #1945

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAAAJyAPrC37zBzbbX

## Before and after UI screenshots

The images show the actual egui shell with the Local Q&A preset and Offline only enabled.
The after image uses an HTTP fixture on `127.0.0.1:11434`. It uses no provider account or API key.

Before: the PR base (`780b0a25a`) refuses the request because no live transport is configured.

![AI Chat before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/282bdb827e30c92fdb8cdb37d5bc3fa0167cf127/2122/before.png)

After: the live transport displays the reply from the loopback HTTP fixture.

![AI Chat after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/282bdb827e30c92fdb8cdb37d5bc3fa0167cf127/2122/after.png)
